prompt:
Create a picture: a cute overheated summer sun reaction icon for a friendly kids' mobile game. A perfectly round golden-yellow face surrounded by eight short rounded orange rays, evenly spaced. Charming little squinting dark eyes, small curved concerned eyebrows, round peach blush cheeks. A small open rounded panting smile with just a tiny pink tongue peeking out, still endearing and sweet. Keep the face yellow, never red-orange. No huge mouth, no big dangling tongue, no heavy sleepy eyelids. No sunglasses. Clean thick even dark-brown outlines, simple soft two-tone shading, one restrained cream highlight. Simple polished cartoon game sticker. One whole sun centered on square white background with margin, no cropping, text, numbers, shadow or other objects.
Keep the art simple and readable at small mobile-game icon sizes. Broad smooth shapes, clean even dark-brown outlines, only 2 or 3 soft shading tones per surface and one or two simple highlights. NO fine texture, intricate veins, realistic surface detail, excessive reflections or ornamental detail. A polished cute cartoon, not a highly rendered illustration. Keep the requested composition and isolated pieces.
